humanReviews.notes: failure class corrected F03 -> F13. Agent log ends in 'API Error: Connection closed mid-response' after the agent had written one file, so the produced-nothing gate skipped it and the evaluator's 'acceptance failed' became F03 incorrect code. A dropped connection mid-implementation is infrastructure. The runner now classifies a failed run whose log ENDS with an infrastructure signature, which catches partials without touching the three passing runs whose logs also end that way.

failure class corrected none -> F15. Telemetry reports 0 model calls and 0 tool calls for a run that passed 7/7 and changed 3 production files in 93s — the collector missed it, the agent did not run for free. Amendment 1(3): missing telemetry is not a measurement of zero, so the run is excluded and replaced rather than entered as the cheapest run in its arm.

failure class corrected F03 -> F12. No API error in the log and no permission denial (13 granted tool calls, 0 denials), so this is not harness trouble. The agent explored, cited the CLAUDE.md guidance, proposed the same annotation-based approach the 8 passing treatment runs implemented, then asked 'Should I proceed?' and stalled headless for 2.9h. F03 'incorrect code' was false — it wrote no code. F12 non-convergence is the accurate class, and unlike F13 it stays in the treatment arm, where a treatment-linked deliberation stall belongs.
